**H1-3b (baseRefOid port widening) shipped as PR #282 — closes H1-2C-BASE; fresh review PR-ready; NIT hardened; blast-radius MINOR logged as fast-follow (unify prView to single gh api call)**

**What**: Step 2 of the H1-3 sequence — the port-widening code slice implementing signed ADR-0022 — is up as **PR #282** (feat/issue-266-h1-3b-port-baseRefOid → tracker issue-266, type:feature). Mirrors #278 (headRefOid).

**Delivered**: `baseRefOid` on `prView` both providers (GitHub via supplementary `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n} --jq .base.sha`; GitLab via `diff_refs.base_sha`; additive, null fail-safe); parameterized contract drift-guard; vcs-contract.md doctrine-sync (in-lane, precedent commit 1982023); **cli.mjs baseSha fallback → `boot.prView.baseRefOid`** which CLOSES H1-2C-BASE (tranche budget + changedFiles now resolve in local runs, not only CI); tranche.mjs stale-comment fix. ~95 counted/400. npm test 1563/1563.

**Verified**: fresh-context adversarial review (opus) verdict **PR-ready** — no blocker/major; cli fallback null-safe (abstain path returns before the `boot.prView` deref); H1-2C-BASE closure proven BOTH ways (resolves via port / still fail-closed §10 when port baseRefOid also null — no APPROVE on uncomputable). Orchestrator independently confirmed `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}` placeholder expansion works (→ csrinaldi/brain).

**NIT fixed (strict TDD)**: `gh api --jq .base.sha` prints literal "null" on JSON-null → now normalized to null in github.mjs (guard `!== 'null'`), symmetric with gitlab's `?? null`.

**Follow-up LOGGED (owner ruled Lectura-A: ship now, unify later)**: MINOR blast-radius — prView's GitHub 2nd call now fires for `ci-context.mjs` (every CI job w/ PR_NUMBER) + `brain-audit.mjs`, which discard baseRefOid. Fix = the single-call unification ADR-0022 already named (fetch head.sha+base.sha+labels+body from one `gh api …/pulls/{n}`). Fast-follow slice, noted in #282 body.

**Gates**: all green except actor-check (detection-only self-approval, standing). local-checks green without AGENTS.md regen (vcs-contract.md is NOT a SOURCE_DOC, unlike HOME.md).

**Next after #282 merges**: the H1-3 checkpoint slice (branch feat/issue-266-h1-3-checkpoint, 7 commits, built + reviewed + fixed, at 399/400) rebases onto merged #282, flips its `deps.baseSha ?? null` → prView().baseRefOid (or receives cli.mjs's resolved baseSha), opens its PR. Watch the 399/400 budget on that wiring edit. Related: [[sdd/issue-266-h1/h1-3-review]], [[sdd/issue-266-h1/standing-conditions]].
